title: Register to use animals for scientific purposes
what: Use animals for scientific purposes only as a registered person (or someone it engages).

sources.title: Animal Protection Act 2018 (NT)
sources.quote: Only the following persons may use, or allow an animal to be used, for scientific purposes: (a) a registered person; (b) an individual engaged by a registered person and acting in the course of that engagement;
